==Objectives==
Report your findings to Vereesa Windrunner.

==Description==
Make haste, <class>! You may still have time to stop [[Rommath]]'s scheme. Go with the wind, and let no one know about this, but Lady Vereesa! The fate of our kin is in your hands.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
*350 XP
*+150 [[reputation]] with [[Silvermoon Remnant]]

==Progress==
How was your investigation?

==Completion==
<Vereesa's countenance pales as you explain the situation to her.>

I... I didn't anticipate that it would be someone from the Regency Council, even in my darkest dreams. Who else is conspiring against us? [[Voren'thal]]? [[Astalor]]? This is profoundly grave news, <name>.
